market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: External pressure (US under Trump, battlefield stalemate) makes a peace deal with a NATO neutrality pledge more likely than 19%. Ukraine could agree to a moratorium on NATO membership to secure a ceasefire or security guarantees, possibly within the next 20 months. The 19% implied probability undervalues this scenario.
evidence_points: Trump has signaled a strong push to end the war quickly, likely demanding Ukraine trade NATO aspirations for peace.
Zelenskyy has hinted at willingness to delay NATO membership if alternative security guarantees are offered.
Various peace proposals (e.g., 10‑year moratorium on NATO) already float a neutrality pledge, making an agreement plausible.
sources_consulted: Analysis of Ukraine’s NATO membership prospects
